entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah Maschil.> It has come to our ears, O God, our fathers have given us the story, of the works which you did in their days, in the old times,

entries.title: Psalms 44:2
segments: Uprooting the nations with your hand, and planting our fathers in their place; cutting down the nations, but increasing the growth of your people.

entries.title: Psalms 44:3
segments: For they did not make the land theirs by their swords, and it was not their arms which kept them safe; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you had pleasure in them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: You are my King and my God; ordering salvation for Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 44:5
segments: Through you will we overcome our haters; by your name will they be crushed under our feet who are violent against us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:6
segments: I will not put faith in my bow, my sword will not be my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 44:7
segments: But it is you who have been our saviour from those who were against us, and have put to shame those who had hate for us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:8
segments: Our pride is in God at all times, to his name we give praise for ever. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 44:9
segments: ¶But now you have sent us away from you, and put us to shame; you do not go out with our armies.

entries.title: Psalms 44:10
segments: Because of this we are turned back by the attacker: those who have hate for us take our goods for themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: You have made us like sheep which are taken for meat; we are put to flight among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 44:12
segments: You let your people go for nothing; your wealth is not increased by their price.

entries.title: Psalms 44:13
segments: You have made us to be looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and shamed by those who are round about us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:14
segments: Our name is a word of shame among the nations, a sign for the shaking of heads among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 44:15
segments: My downfall is ever before me, and I am covered with the shame of my face;

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: Because of the voice of him who says sharp and bitter words; because of the hater and him who is the instrument of punishment.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: ¶All this has come on us, but still we have kept you in our memory; and we have not been false to your word.

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: Our hearts have not gone back, and our steps have not been turned out of your way;

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: Though you have let us be crushed in the place of jackals, though we are covered with darkest shade.

entries.title: Psalms 44:20
segments: If the name of our God has gone out of our minds, or if our hands have been stretched out to a strange god,

entries.title: Psalms 44:21
segments: Will not God make search for it? for he sees the secrets of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: Truly, because of you we are put to death every day; we are numbered like sheep for destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 44:23
segments: Why are you sleeping, O Lord? awake! and come to our help, do not give us up for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 44:24
segments: Why is your face covered, and why do you give no thought to our trouble and our cruel fate?

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: For our souls are crushed down to the dust: our bodies are stretched out on the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 44:26
segments: Up! and come to our help, and give us salvation because of your mercy.
